title: Android spend approval fails open when the device-credential prompt is unavailable (MOB-02)
body:
From the 2026-10-10 codebase-health audit (MOB-02). Not fixed by the remediation commits.

On Android, when the device-credential prompt cannot be created, the larger-payment approval falls open and the payment is approved with no authentication.

In `bins/openagents-android/host/app/src/main/java/com/openagents/app/AgentPayments.kt`, `approve()` calls `keyguard.createConfirmDeviceCredentialIntent(...)`. When that returns null, the non-trust branch runs `bridge.spend(op, "request" to request)` — approving the payment anyway:

```kotlin
val intent = keyguard.createConfirmDeviceCredentialIntent(...) ?: run {
    if (trust) { failure = "..."; shown = null; update(bridge.packet) }
    else bridge.spend(op, "request" to request)   // <-- approves without auth
    return
}
```

Rust already decides when authentication is required (`crates/openagents-mobile/src/spend.rs`, `AUTHENTICATE_ABOVE_MSAT = 1_000_000`). The Android host must not weaken that: a null prompt should refuse, not approve.

## Fix

Fail closed on Android when the credential intent is null (refuse and show the failure), matching the iOS path. Consider requiring an authenticated flag in Rust so a platform host cannot skip it.

Location: `bins/openagents-android/host/app/src/main/java/com/openagents/app/AgentPayments.kt:127-134`.
